title: Kronos for Defense
headline: Sovereign energy, at the edge.
tagline: How Kronos serves defense — resilient sovereign power from the burner (Aegis) and strategic isotopes from the breeder (tritium, helium-3, 14 MeV neutrons). Public-only; honest about design stage.

resilient-sovereign-power: Aegis power for bases and installations, untethered from fuel convoys.
strategic-isotopes-for-defense: Tritium for the stockpile, helium-3 for detection, 14 MeV neutrons for materials.
energy-security-logistics: Cutting the fuel-logistics tail; energy independence.
national-security-applications: Neutron and isotope services for national security.
readiness-standards: Honest gates, standards, and a responsible dual-use posture.
